summary.text: Ana Tiburcio represents Pennsylvania's 22nd Legislative District in the state House of Representatives, to which she was elected in February 2026.
Her official biography says she previously served on the Allentown School District Board of Directors from 2023 to 2026.

paragraphs.text: Before joining the House, Tiburcio served from 2023 to 2026 as a program coordinator for the Fine Feather Foundation, a nonprofit that empowers youth through creativity, education and mentorship.
She owns A&M Tax & Services and is involved with Allentown Works, the Allentown city beautification project Love Your Block and Allentown Blueprint Communities.
She attended Northampton Community College and has lived in Allentown for nearly three decades.

Her committee assignments include Environmental & Natural Resource Protection, Gaming Oversight, Housing & Community Development and Intergovernmental Affairs & Operations, and she belongs to the PA Legislative Latino Caucus.
